source_statement: Let △ABC be an equilateral triangle with side length 6. Let P be a point inside triangle △ABC such that ∠BP C = 120◦ . The circle with diameter AP meets the circumcircle of △ABC again at X ̸= A. Given that AX = 5, compute XP .

clause_ledger.source: P inside ABC and angle BPC=120 degrees
clause_ledger.dsl: P is free with three positive subtriangle-area guards and direct Angle(B,P,C) constraint

clause_ledger.source: circle with diameter AP and circumcircle ABC meet again at X != A
clause_ledger.dsl: direct Circle(Midpoint(A,P),Distance(A,P)/2), Circumcircle(A,B,C), and OnCircle constraints; AX=5 excludes A
